changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwicdcode AS SELECT ic.id, ic.code, ic.description, ic.version, ic.is_active, ic.last_updated FROM public.icd10_code ic;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwicdcode TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwicdcode FROM report_user;
